conceptZh: 浣熊助手花生踮腳把鋼條越疊越高，放上最後一顆小墊圈就急著敬禮，整座塔轟然倒下，鋼條排成「鋼」，他被散落的零件埋得只露出兩眼。
object: A teetering stack of cobalt-blue steel strips, a tiny steel washer, and a few rounded steel offcuts.
morph: The falling strips spread across the floor into a flat, standard Traditional Chinese 鋼, with 金 on the left and 岡 on the right. The washer and offcuts roll aside and bury Peanut up to his eyes.
creativeAngle: 花生好不容易用尾巴扶正鋼塔，卻在放上最輕的一片墊圈時急著敬禮。倒塌的鋼條向中央攤成字，剩下的零件往角落滾，讓花生只露出兩眼也能完成敬禮笑點。
promptEn:
Make an exactly 8-second stylized animated short on a pale butter-yellow workshop floor. Use one locked, nearly overhead shot. Peanut, an original cartoon raccoon sidekick with a springy ringed tail and an absurdly serious salute, works just to the lower right of center. Frame his whole stack and leave the middle clear for the landing.

0.0–1.5 seconds. Peanut hustles in carrying a stack of cobalt-blue steel strips taller than himself. He spots one last long strip on the floor, plants the stack, and reaches for that strip with a determined squint. As he lays it across the top and the steel gives a light clink, speak the first 鋼.

1.5–3.3 seconds. Peanut rises onto tiptoe to straighten the new strip. He misses the middle and the tower swings wide. He catches it with his tail, beams, and sets one tiny steel washer dead center on top. A half-beat of perfect balance. He whips a paw up to salute and lifts his tail away at the same instant. The washer tips onto its rim and the whole stack follows.

3.3–4.9 seconds. One soft, springy BONK sends the strips tumbling inward across the floor, face up. They settle together as the second 鋼 is spoken. Their solid blue faces form the exact standard Traditional Chinese 鋼, with a narrow eight-stroke 金 on the left and a wider 岡 on the right. Give 岡 a straight, square 冂 outline with a hooked right leg, two short slants above an inner horizontal, and a three-pronged 山 tucked below that bar inside the frame. The washer and a few rounded offcuts tumble the other way and bury Peanut in the lower-right corner, with only his blinking eyes peeking out.

4.9–8.0 seconds. Hold the flat, centered glyph perfectly still and uncropped at about 70% of frame height, with clear margins. Around 5.7 seconds, Peanut reaches one paw out of the heap and tips a thick steel offcut toward the light, revealing its shiny cut edge exactly as the voice says 鋼鐵. He sets it down and gives one tiny salute from the heap, well clear of the strokes.

Use a warm off-screen Taiwanese Mandarin voice. The entire spoken line is 鋼、鋼、鋼鐵 (ㄍㄤ、ㄍㄤ、ㄍㄤ ㄊㄧㄝˇ). Read exactly those syllables slowly and distinctly, with clear tones and a short pause between utterances. Stop after 鋼鐵. Keep the clink and BONK gentle and below the voice. Show only 鋼 as on-screen text. Keep the floor uncluttered and the lighting soft and steady.
